flows.title: Use a green screen
steps: In your StreamYard studio, click Settings.
Tick the box for 'I have a green screen'.
Choose a virtual background from the ones offered, or upload your own image.
Light the backdrop evenly so it is the same shade of green all over, and wear nothing that colour — the more contrast, the better.
If it does not work, turn hardware acceleration on in your browser's settings: the green screen needs the graphics processor, and the browser can be what is blocking it.

flows.title: Connect a Facebook Page to stream to
steps: Before this can work, Meta requires the Facebook account to be at least 60 days old and the Facebook Page or professional mode profile to have at least 100 followers.
Open the Destinations tab, click Add a Destination, then Facebook Page, and select your page from the list that appears.
If your page is not in the list, check that you hold Facebook access or task access to create content for it.
Check too that you are on the Facebook profile that holds the page: click your profile picture at the top right of facebook.com to see which one you are on.
If you picked 'Choose what you allow' when first connecting, StreamYard may not reach that page, or any page you joined afterwards; reauthorise Facebook to put that right.
A Profile and a Group are not a Page: choose the Facebook Profile option for a profile. Followers mean a Page, friends mean a Profile, and members mean a Group.
